card.title: D3TaLES: DFT Computations for Redox-Active Small Organic Molecule
card.description:
This dataset contains cleaned data for 35,729 molecules marked as `public` in the D<sup>3</sup>TaLES database at 
the time of this dataset's creation. The calculations data were generated through a high-throughput molecular computational workflow 
using density functional theory (DFT) carried out at the (IP-tuned) LC-ωHPBE/Def2SVP level of 
theory via the Gaussian16 (rev A.03) software suite. More details can be found in the associated
publication: [https://doi.org/10.1039/D3DD00081H](https://doi.org/10.1039/D3DD00081H).  
This dataset excludes molecules with outlier properties. An outlier 
is considered a property value greater than 3 standard deviations from the mean. 


The dataset contains over 90 possible properties for each molecule. All energy properties are given 
in eV. Properties that begin with `solv_` were calculated in implicit solvent conditions simulating 
acetonitrile (dielectric constant 35.688). More information can be found in the README.md file, and 
complete documentation for molecular and species properties can 
be found in the D<sup>3</sup>TaLES documentation at [https://d3tales.as.uky.edu/docs](https://d3tales.as.uky.edu/docs).
